comment: Recovery map for 15 product-gap-review recommendations whose recorded use_case_id went stale after make-fix re-keyed the AUTOINCREMENT IDs. Names were extracted from the dashboard repo's DB at commits 8725e34 (14 rows) and 5ca23e4 (1 row, BTSSS) — those commits' DB tree corresponds to the state when the gap-review agents authored the recommendations. The (agency_abbr, use_case_name) pair is verified unique in the current DB, so a tier-3 resolver fallback can match exactly. apply_product_gap_review.py reads this file at startup.
